item.title: EVE Energy, Green Whale Technology Partner to Accelerate Global Marine Battery Adoption
item.description: In a move to accelerate the future of marine electrification, EVE Energy, and Green Whale Technology (GWT) have signed a strategic partnership agreement to provide high-performance marine Battery Energy Storage Solutions (BESS) and service to customers worldwide.
